snippet.title: Stream Train - "Entertain the Chat" Dev Diary
snippet.description:
Learn all about the chat system that drives Stream Train. Your viewers are hungry for content, keep them satiated to stay alive.

Stream Train is a co-op adventure where up to 6 players livestream their trip through the Uncanny Valley. Grow your audience by taunting cryptid creatures, doing dangerous stunts, and pranking your friends. Can you make it through the valley alive?

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4071650/
